searches.system: WebSearch / CIIS Digital Commons / ATP Journal Archive / Semantic Scholar
queries: transpersonal psychology history founding 1969 Sutich Maslow Grof ATP Journal of Transpersonal Psychology scholarly
Grof 2008 Brief History of Transpersonal Psychology International Journal Transpersonal Studies CIIS open access
Sutich 1969 Some Considerations Regarding Transpersonal Psychology Journal of Transpersonal Psychology ATP archive
searches.purpose: Locate the institutional founding moment (Sutich 1969 JTP inaugural issue) and an independent scholarly history by a co-founder (Grof 2008 IJTS). Wikipedia and New Age/coaching sites (psychicscience.org, positivepsychology.com, marinamecheva.com, groflegacyproject.org) excluded as non-scholarly or promotional. The Maslow 1969 JTP Theory Z and various-meanings articles were identified but the ATP archive PDFs for those specific issues were not accessible via WebFetch; the Sutich JTP 1(1) PDF was located and is genuine (97KB, 10 pages, OCR-scanned).

queries: Lajoie Shapiro 1992 definitions of transpersonal psychology Journal of Transpersonal Psychology content analysis scholarly
Hartelius Caplan Rardin 2007 transpersonal psychology definition twenty-one themes International Journal of Transpersonal Psychology
Grof 1985 Beyond the Brain transpersonal holotropic SUNY Press free access archive primary work
searches.purpose: Locate theory-and-methods sources: the Lajoie and Shapiro 1992 thematic analysis of definitions across 23 years (JTP 24(1), 79-98) is the most-cited definitional overview; Grof 1985 Beyond the Brain is available on Internet Archive but Internet Archive item is borrow-only access-restricted, not free download, so registered as excluded pointer rather than cached. Hartelius, Caplan and Rardin 2007 identified three definitional themes in The Humanistic Psychologist 35(2) but is not open access; Grof 2008 IJTS Brief History (open CC license) covers founding theory alongside identity history and is the primary cached source for this slot.

searches.system: WebSearch / Galileo Commission / ATP Journal Archive / CIIS Digital Commons / Wiley Online Library
queries: transpersonal psychology critique not a science New Age pseudoscience academic criticism Rowan Ferrer scholarly
Walach 2013 Wiley-Blackwell Handbook Transpersonal Psychology criticism chapter full text open institutional repository
Ferrer 2014 transpersonal psychology science supernatural Journal of Transpersonal Psychology ATP archive
searches.purpose: Locate independent scholarly critiques outside the field. Walach 2013 book chapter 'Criticisms of Transpersonal Psychology and Beyond' (pp. 62-87 in Wiley-Blackwell Handbook) is available as a PDF on Galileo Commission site (127KB, genuine, author-posted); confirmed as Walach not Walsh, Wiley chapter posted by author/rights holder. Ferrer 2014 'Transpersonal Psychology, Science, and the Supernatural' in JTP 46(2) is available from ATP archive (200KB, 35 pages, genuine). Daniels 2005 Shadow, Self, Spirit is borrow-only on Internet Archive and commercial otherwise; excluded. Academic.edu copy of Friedman 2002 IJTS was located; the CIIS Digital Commons landing page confirmed CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 but the direct PDF download returned 403.

searches.system: WebSearch / PubMed / NCBI E-utilities / University of Pennsylvania institutional site / SAGE Journals
queries: transpersonal psychology empirical research altered states consciousness self-transcendence systematic review peer-reviewed open access
Nardini-Bubols 2019 altered states consciousness transpersonal approach psychotherapy systematic review Journal of Religion and Health
Yaden Haidt Hood Vago Newberg 2017 varieties of self-transcendent experience Review of General Psychology open access
searches.purpose: Locate empirical assessments. Nardini-Bubols et al. 2019 (PMID 31227981) is the only systematic review of altered-states transpersonal psychotherapy found (14 studies from 629 screened); full text is paywalled (Springer), caching NCBI E-utilities abstract XML as formal pointer. Yaden et al. 2017 'Varieties of Self-Transcendent Experience' in Review of General Psychology 21(2) is available as author-manuscript PDF on University of Pennsylvania PPC site (860KB); it is not specifically a transpersonal psychology article but provides the empirical taxonomy of self-transcendence constructs central to the field. Psychedelic-assisted therapy literature (psilocybin, ketamine RCTs) was identified but not selected: those clinical intervention studies belong to a separate empirical literature and would conflate transpersonal psychology the academic subdiscipline with specific clinical applications.

searches.purpose: Confirm ongoing institutional status of ATP and JTP. The ATP official website (atpweb.org) is active, hosts the JTP, lists events (including July 2026 forum), and publishes newsletters. Transpersonalcommunity.org is a separate associated community site. No confusion with generic 'transpersonal coaching' or 'spiritual care' commercial pages.

queries: transpersonal psychology India Buddhism East Asia non-Western reception academic critique open access 2000 2010 2020
transpersonal psychology Spanish Portuguese psicologia transpersonal systematic review OR history non-English open access scholarly
transpersonal psychology Islamic worldview self-transcendence peer-reviewed open access non-Western critique 2024
Banerji 2023 Western Buddhism Transpersonal Psychology Cross-Hermeneutic IJTS CIIS open access
searches.purpose: Locate non-English or non-Western cultural context sources. A dedicated Spanish/Portuguese language transpersonal psychology systematic review was not found in accessible open form. Banerji 2023 IJTS 42(2) 'Western Buddhism and Transpersonal Psychology' (CC BY-NC-ND 4.0, CIIS Digital Commons, 203KB PDF) is a scholarly introduction to a special issue examining cross-cultural hermeneutic tensions including concerns about decontextualised Buddhist techniques. Arroisi, Muhsinin and Fadlilah 2024 (IJEIIS 4(1), CC BY-NC 4.0, open access, 303KB PDF) provides a non-Western critique of transpersonal psychology's concept of self-transcendence from an Islamic worldview perspective. Both are selected: the Banerji piece represents East Asian/Buddhist reception; the Arroisi piece represents Islamic non-Western critique. Indigenous spiritual practices of specific peoples and MBSR/MBCT clinical mindfulness are distinct fields and were not conflated with transpersonal psychology.

items.title: Transpersonal Psychology in Context: Perspectives from Its Founders and Historians of American Psychology
items.rights_note: Journal of Transpersonal Psychology 39(2) 2007, pp. 153-174. Author Nicole Ruzek (Pomona, CA) is an independent researcher, not a founder of the field, providing external scholarly framing. The article gathers perspectives from both founders of transpersonal psychology and historians of mainstream American psychology, addressing whether it constitutes a subdiscipline or fourth force. ATP archive PDF (164KB, 22 pages, creation 2008); publicly readable without paywall; cache privately.

items.title: Brief History of Transpersonal Psychology
items.rights_note: Creative Commons Attribution-Noncommercial-No Derivative Works 4.0 License; CIIS Digital Commons. DOI 10.24972/ijts.2008.27.1.46. CIIS Digital Commons returned a 3KB JavaScript shell rather than the PDF body (automated request blocked); cached file deleted. Registered as excluded pointer with valid DOI. The Ruzek 2007 JTP article serves as the identity_history cached source instead.

items.title: Definitions of Transpersonal Psychology: The First Twenty-Three Years
items.rights_note: Hosted in the ATP Journal archive as an OCR-scanned PDF (155KB, 20 pages, creation date 2003, modification 2007). No explicit open-license statement; publicly readable without paywall. Cache privately.

items.title: Criticisms of Transpersonal Psychology and Beyond — The Future of Transpersonal Psychology: A Science and Culture of Consciousness
items.rights_note: Book chapter pp. 62-87 in H.L. Friedman & G. Hartelius (Eds.) The Wiley-Blackwell Handbook of Transpersonal Psychology (2013). Hosted on Galileo Commission website as a genuine PDF (127KB, 26 pages); appears to be an author-posted copy. Note: the Galileo Commission page labels the author as 'Walsh' but the correct author is Harald Walach (W.A.L.A.C.H). Cache privately; Wiley book chapter rights apply.

items.title: Transpersonal Psychology, Science, and the Supernatural
items.rights_note: From Journal of Transpersonal Psychology 46(2) 2014, hosted in ATP Journal archive (200KB, 35 pages). Ferrer argues from inside the field that transpersonal psychology's relationship to science is contested; functions as both an internal boundary-analysis and methodological critique.

items.title: The Altered States of Consciousness in Transpersonal Approach Psychotherapy: Systematic Review and Guidelines for Research and Clinical Practice
items.rights_note: Full text is paywalled (Springer, DOI 10.1007/s10943-019-00855-1); no PMC open-access copy found. Caching NCBI E-utilities official abstract XML as formal bibliographic pointer. This is abstract-level only — not full-text evidence. The review screened 629 articles and analysed 14 empirical studies on altered-states transpersonal psychotherapy; findings noted improvement in substance-use disorder, relaxation and pain relief, with call for rigorous experimental designs.

items.title: The Varieties of Self-Transcendent Experience
items.rights_note: Author-manuscript PDF on University of Pennsylvania Positive Psychology Center institutional site (860KB). Publisher version is paywalled on SAGE. This review provides an empirical taxonomy of self-transcendent experiences (mindfulness, flow, peak experiences, mystical-type experiences) central to transpersonal psychology's subject matter; it is not itself a transpersonal psychology article but constitutes independent empirical literature directly relevant to the field's core constructs.

items.title: Association for Transpersonal Psychology — Official Website
items.rights_note: Official ATP website confirming the association is active (events including July 2026 forum), publishes JTP, maintains membership directory and newsletter. Institutional self-description only; not independent validation.

items.title: Western Buddhism and Transpersonal Psychology: Cross-Hermeneutic and Engaged Approaches
items.rights_note: Creative Commons Attribution-Noncommercial-No Derivative Works 4.0 License; hosted on CIIS Digital Commons. The CIIS landing page confirms a 203KB PDF. The Semantic Scholar PDF is the same open-access article. Examines cross-cultural hermeneutic tensions between Western transpersonal psychology and Asian Buddhist traditions; not conflated with specific Indigenous peoples' practices or with MBSR/MBCT clinical mindfulness.

items.title: Self-Transcendence in Transpersonal Psychology: A Critical Review from the Perspective of the Islamic Worldview
items.rights_note: Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0 International License. International Journal of Emerging Issues in Islamic Studies 4(1) 2024 (DOI 10.31098/ijeiis.v4i1.2432). University of Darussalam Gontor authors; provides an Islamic-framework critique of the self-transcendence concept in transpersonal psychology, arguing it is infected with Western anthropocentric assumptions.

items.title: Beyond the Brain: Birth, Death, and Transcendence in Psychotherapy
items.rights_note: Available on Internet Archive as borrow-only (access-restricted item); not freely downloadable. Grof 1985, SUNY Press. Not cached — borrow-only access does not meet retrieval threshold. Registered as excluded pointer. The Sutich 1969 JTP article is the primary cached source for founding programme statements.
